cases.title: Replies can be collected in a different order from requests
cases.source: sw_probe(echo(X),State,reply(X),State). sw_probe(block(Observer),State,released,State) :- self(Me), Observer ! sw_blocked(Me), receive({release -> true}). sw_probe(die_now,_,_,_) :- exit(sw_death). sw_probe(die_later(Observer),_,_,_) :- self(Me), Observer ! sw_blocked(Me), receive({crash -> exit(sw_death)}).
